observations: The page number «55» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02 end the example of Venus begun on p. 54 (JP2 0086, L18-L35). L06-L07 and L14-L15: the headings of chapters 12 and 13, in bold, centred, each with the reference to the text below it.

L01-L05. Checked: 114° 28½′ + 59° 9′ = 173° 37½′ (p. 54, L34-L35), which is 23° 37½′ of Virgo (from 150°); 181° 17′ − 173° 37½′ = 7° 39½′, Suter's «etwa 7° 40′». The «10°» of Saturn is the difference of the mean longitudes, 9° 40′ (p. 54, JP2 0086, L01-L03).

L16-L30: the stations: the column «Statio prima» of the tables of the equations, entered with the centrum aequatum, gives the anomaly of the first station, and 360° less it that of the second; the planet is stationary when its anomaly equals one of them, retrograde between them, direct otherwise. N01-N04. Checked: the second station being 360° less the first, and greater than it, no anomaly can be greater than the second and at the same time less than the first, so that al-Battānī's condition with «et» is never fulfilled; with «aut» it is the complement of the arc of retrogradation, as Suter says. «wa» and «aw» (N03), the Arabic «and» and «or», in italics.

L34-L35: the two values of p. 53 (JP2 0085): the centrum aequatum, 139° 31′ 30″ (L17-L18), and the argument (anomaly) examinatum, 109° 24′ 30″ (L21-L22), here called «Anomalia aequata»; set in two columns, each head centred over its value. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed.

L25: «stationnär», as printed. L21: «(examinat.)», the word in italics within upright brackets; L23 «(elheza)» likewise. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: «wahre Länge» (L01), «Statio prima», «Statio secunda», «Centrum aequat.», «Anomalia … examinata», «Beispiel», and the Latin and Arabic words of N01-N03.
The colons, semicolons and the question mark stand after the thin space of the edition (11-15 px measured; «d. H. ?» 13 px, «Batt. :» in N01 14 px, «aut ;» in N02 11 px).
